title: ParaEMT Configuration
description: JSON Schema for the ParaEMT runtime configuration. This schema describes parameter names, data types, defaults, and basic validation rules. The runtime parameter values remain stored in Config.json.

name.title: Name
name.description: Component instance name. Also used as the HELICS federate name, so publications are named <name>/<stream>.

PowerFlowParameters.title: Power Flow Parameters
PowerFlowParameters.description: Parameters used by the power-flow initialization.

systemN.title: System Identifier
systemN.description: Identifier or version number of the power-system case used for power-flow initialization.

SimulationParameters.title: Simulation Parameters
SimulationParameters.description: General ParaEMT simulation, output, playback, and HELICS settings.

systemN.title: System Identifier
systemN.description: Identifier or version number of the system case used by the EMT simulation.

ts.title: Simulation Time Step
ts.description: EMT simulation time step in seconds.

DSrate.title: Downsampling Rate
DSrate.description: Number of simulation steps between recorded or published output samples.

netMod.title: Network Solution Mode
netMod.description: Network equation solution method or implementation mode.

dump_all.title: Dump All Results
dump_all.description: Whether to dump all available simulation results.

show_progress.title: Show Progress
show_progress.description: Whether to display simulation progress during execution.

save_results_csv.title: Save Results as CSV
save_results_csv.description: Whether to save simulation results in CSV format.

N_row.title: Partition Rows
N_row.description: Number of row partitions used by the simulation layout or decomposition.

N_col.title: Partition Columns
N_col.description: Number of column partitions used by the simulation layout or decomposition.

SimMod.title: Simulation Mode
SimMod.description: Integer code selecting the ParaEMT simulation mode.

save_snapshot.title: Save Snapshot
save_snapshot.description: Integer flag controlling whether a simulation snapshot is saved.

save_snapshot_mode.title: Snapshot Mode
save_snapshot_mode.description: Integer code selecting the snapshot-saving mode.

t_release_f.title: Release Time
t_release_f.description: Release or switching time used by the selected simulation mode, in seconds.

loadmodel_option.title: Load Model Option
loadmodel_option.description: Integer code selecting the load-model option.

EMT_N.title: EMT Model Count or Index
EMT_N.description: Integer parameter identifying the EMT model count, partition, or selected EMT subsystem.

kts.title: Time-Step Index
kts.description: Integer time-step-related index used internally by the simulation.

stepk.title: Simulation Step Index
stepk.description: Integer simulation-step index used internally by the simulation.

record4cosim.title: Record for Co-simulation
record4cosim.description: Whether to record data intended for co-simulation.

playback_enable.title: Enable Playback
playback_enable.description: Whether the playback workflow is enabled.

flag_changeKp.title: Enable Kp Change
flag_changeKp.description: Whether the controller proportional gain is changed during the simulation.

Kp_new.title: New Kp Value
Kp_new.description: Replacement proportional gain used when flag_changeKp is enabled.

helics_live_enable.title: Enable HELICS Live Publishing
helics_live_enable.description: Whether simulation data are published live through HELICS. Must be enabled when running under OEDISI, otherwise no streams are published.

helics_period.title: HELICS Publishing Period
helics_period.description: Requested HELICS publication period in seconds.

oedi_start_timestamp.title: OEDI Start Timestamp
oedi_start_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of simulation time zero, used for the time field of published HELICS payloads.

ForcedOscillationParameters.title: Forced Oscillation Parameters
ForcedOscillationParameters.description: Parameters for injecting a forced oscillation into a selected generator controller.

enabled.title: Enable Forced Oscillation
enabled.description: Whether the forced-oscillation event is active.

target_gen.title: Target Generator
target_gen.description: Generator identifier or index to which the oscillation is applied.

flag_exc_gov_fo.title: Exciter or Governor Selection
flag_exc_gov_fo.description: Integer flag selecting whether the forced oscillation is applied through the exciter or governor.

magnitude.title: Oscillation Magnitude
magnitude.description: Amplitude of the injected forced oscillation.

frequency_hz.title: Oscillation Frequency
frequency_hz.description: Frequency of the injected forced oscillation in hertz.

lock_ini.title: Lock Initial Value
lock_ini.description: Integer flag controlling whether an initial value is locked.

lock_value.title: Locked Value
lock_value.description: Value used when lock_ini is enabled.

enabled.title: Enable Generator Trip
enabled.description: Whether the generator-trip event is active.

target_gen.title: Target Generator
target_gen.description: Generator identifier or index to trip.

flag_reinit.title: Reinitialization Flag
flag_reinit.description: Integer flag controlling model reinitialization after the trip.

BusFaultParameters.title: Bus Fault Parameters
BusFaultParameters.description: Parameters for applying a bus fault and optionally tripping a line.

enabled.title: Enable Bus Fault
enabled.description: Whether the bus-fault event is active.

fault_bus_idx.title: Faulted Bus Index
fault_bus_idx.description: Index of the bus at which the fault is applied.

fault_type.title: Fault Type
fault_type.description: Integer code identifying the electrical fault type.

fault_r.title: Fault Resistance Parameters
fault_r.description: Six numerical fault-resistance or conductance-related values used by the fault model.

trip_line.title: Trip Line
trip_line.description: Integer flag controlling whether a line is tripped in association with the fault.

fault_line_idx.title: Faulted Line Index
fault_line_idx.description: Index of the line associated with the fault or post-fault trip.

StatePerturbationParameters.title: State Perturbation Parameters
StatePerturbationParameters.description: Parameters for perturbing a selected state of a selected device.

enabled.title: Enable State Perturbation
enabled.description: Whether the state-perturbation event is active.

dx.title: State Perturbation Magnitude
dx.description: Increment applied to the selected state.

type.title: Device Type
type.description: Integer code identifying the device category whose state is perturbed.

device_index.title: Device Index
device_index.description: Index of the device whose state is perturbed.

state_index.title: State Index
state_index.description: Index of the state variable to perturb.

StepChangeParameters.title: Step Change Parameters
StepChangeParameters.description: Parameters for applying a step change through a selected generator controller.

enabled.title: Enable Step Change
enabled.description: Whether the step-change event is active.

target_gen.title: Target Generator
target_gen.description: Generator identifier or index to which the step change is applied.

flag_exc_gov.title: Exciter or Governor Selection
flag_exc_gov.description: Integer flag selecting whether the step change is applied through the exciter or governor.

magnitude.title: Step Magnitude
magnitude.description: Magnitude of the applied step change.
